node.statement: Invoke lem-stage1-polar-path-admissibility and choose its universal witnesses A,B >= 1 and k in (0,1/2]. Invoke lem-stage1-polar-retraction-transport and choose its universal witnesses P >= 1 and rho in (0,1/2]. Define C_path^0 := A, C_pol^0 := max{B,P}, and kappa_pol^0 := min{k,rho}. Then C_path^0,C_pol^0 >= 1 and kappa_pol^0 lies in (0,1/2], and all three constants are universal; this choice is made before the receiving tuple W is quantified.
